title: Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A classic Middle Eastern dish featuring marinated chicken kebabs grilled to perfection. Perfect for a quick and flavorful dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, kebab seasoning, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breasts to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
